messages:
Alex: NexaSupply reported 6/40 H100s blocked at AMS customs, marked as 'inspection required'. Can vendor confirm reason and whether we can cross-dock to our EU depot?
Priya: Are these the units from order #RDW-9102? We need serials to open a faster customs clearance.
NexaSupply: Hi team — confirmed these are RDW-9102 batch. Customs flagged missing commercial invoice details for two pallets. We're working customs side but ETA unclear.
Jordan: If customs holds >48h we need an air-split for the urgent 10 units earmarked for Dedicated pools in r/w-eu-1. Can NexaSupply quote expedited air for a 10-unit partial replace?
NexaSupply: We can do partial air-replace. Expedited air uplift is +28% on unit price or flat $6,500/unit depending on routing. ETA 48–72h from AWB pickup. Need confirmation on consolidation: single AWB or per-unit AWB?
Sophie: Consolidate into one AWB if possible — lowers brokerage and reduces per-shipment customs fees. Also send HS codes and full invoice with VAT breakdown.
Alex: rma-bot: created RMA ticket RMA-8342 for the two DOA candidates. Please attach serials: 
```
AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784
Depot: AMS-crossdock-2
```
Priya: Also confirm whether these are H100 PCIe v2 or v3. We saw a firmware mismatch on one returned unit last week; need to avoid sending incorrect firmware.
NexaSupply: These are H100 v3. We'll confirm firmware image and include manifest. We'll also provide a single commercial invoice with HS 8471.50 and declared value per Redwood PO.
Ken: On pricing — if we do 10-unit air-expedite for Dedicated pool, can NexaSupply offer a temporary buffer discount on next committed allocation? We need cushion for the next quarter.
NexaSupply: We can offer a 5% credit on the next 20-unit allocation if you commit within 30 days. Discount applies only to identical SKUs and needs a signed addendum.
Jordan: Fine, but we need SLA on transit + customs clearance. Addendum should include guaranteed pickup within 24h of confirm and alternate routing if AMS rejects.
Sophie: Also flag insurance: vendor to include door-to-door insurance for cross-docked AWB and list any deductibles. We had a previous claim delayed because insurance excluded customs holds.
NexaSupply: Noted — we'll add door-to-door CIF+insurance 0.5% with deductible $1k. If customs hold due to missing docs, vendor will pay expedited courier fee but not duty.
Alex: Quick ops ask — provide a manifest CSV with columns: SKU, serial, RMA#, PO#, invoice#, AWB. Upload to our shared S3 link: https://s3.redwood.internal/rma/8342 (vendor access granted).
Priya: Can you start cross-dock plan now and send estimated pick/transfer times? If customs clears one pallet we can stagger shipments to minimize downtime.
NexaSupply: Starting cross-dock planning. Tentative pickup @ AMS depot 2026-06-04 05:00 UTC pending docs. We'll attach manifest and AWB within 3 hours.
rma-bot: RMA-8342 status updated -> vendor_docs_requested. Next reminder in 6h. :clock3: 
Alex: Thanks. If customs drags, we want an alternative: can you confirm a replacement batch from our US reserve and expedited intercontinental move? Need cost delta and ETA.
NexaSupply: US reserve option available — add $9k/unit for same-day pick + international air (2–3 day transit) due to expedited handling. ETA 3–5 days to EU depot. Will confirm final routing and insurance.
Ken: Agree to proceed with cross-dock + 10-unit air-swap if NexaSupply signs the addendum with the 5% allocation credit and pickup SLA. Ops to prepare acceptance and sign-off.
Jordan: I'll coordinate canary routing on r/w-eu-1 to avoid impacting Dedicated SLAs.
Sophie: Please cc finance on final invoice adjustments — we need a single consolidated invoice for accounting.
NexaSupply: Understood. We'll send the addendum and consolidated invoice draft within 4h.
Alex: Great. Keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
